mapper.select: /* SQL ID : SmnrTrgtrDAO.smnrTrgtrCntnUrlSelect 설 명 : 세미나대상자접속URL조회 */ SELECT TRGTR.* FROM TB_LMS_ONLN_MEETNGRM MEETNGRM JOIN TB_LMS_SMNR_TRGTR TRGTR ON MEETNGRM.ONLN_MEETNGRM_ID = TRGTR.ONLN_MEETNGRM_ID AND TRGTR.PREREGYN = 'Y' WHERE MEETNGRM.SMNR_ID = #{smnrId} AND TRGTR.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: /* SQL ID : SmnrTrgtrDAO.smnrTrgtrRegist 설 명 : 세미나대상자등록 */ MERGE INTO TB_LMS_SMNR_TRGTR TRGTR USING ( SELECT #{smnrTrgtrId} AS SMNR_TRGTR_ID , #{smnrId} AS SMNR_ID , #{userId} AS USER_ID , #{onlnMeetngrmId} AS ONLN_MEETNGRM_ID , #{trgtrCntnUrl} AS TRGTR_CNTN_URL , #{preregyn} AS PREREGYN FROM DUAL ) USR ON ( TRGTR.SMNR_TRGTR_ID = USR.SMNR_TRGTR_ID AND TRGTR.SMNR_ID = USR.SMNR_ID AND TRGTR.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TRGTR.TRGTR_CNTN_URL = USR.TRGTR_CNTN_URL , TRGTR.MDFR_ID = USR.USER_ID , TRGTR.MOD_DTTM = FN_DTTM() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SMNR_TRGTR_ID , SMNR_ID , USER_ID , ONLN_MEETNGRM_ID , TRGTR_CNTN_URL , PREREGYN , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM ) VALUES ( USR.SMNR_TRGTR_ID , USR.SMNR_ID , USR.USER_ID , USR.ONLN_MEETNGRM_ID , USR.TRGTR_CNTN_URL , USR.PREREGYN , USR.USER_ID , FN_DTTM() )
